title: A content sprint from the research queue lands on headless Sonnet with no operator step beyond its gates
goal: This sprint is the content sprint from the research queue, narrowed by the operator on 2026-10-08 to two queue gap findings: F-68c59a20a679 (cargo metadata --no-deps and whether it invokes rustc, .cargo/config.toml build.rustc; topic agents/codebase-mapping, kb/public/_gaps.md:1124) and F-114b1ea76574 (Python os.link: same-filesystem requirement, EXDEV, Windows NTFS support; topic python/stdlib-windows-portability, kb/public/_gaps.md:1058); F-384650090243 is left out, its question being backlog text. Each finding gets one research task worked by a headless claude -p --model sonnet worker through /kb-research --queue: DOC or CODE facts in the topic with source rows, a Resolved note under its _gaps.md entry naming the finding id, python3 _tools/querylog.py close F-ID --claim, and its question packs coverage good; python3 _tools/backlog.py cost --research then lists each task with a closed gap. The operator's only steps are the sprint's start gate and the gates its items raise, and the review files its gaps as parked drafts. The sprint's close commit is this story's evidence.

run: import subprocess,sys;o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/querylog.py','queue'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;left=[f for f in ('F-68c59a20a679','F-114b1ea76574') if f in o];print('still queued:',left or 'none');sys.exit(1 if left else 0)

import subprocess,sys;o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','cost','--research'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;miss=[i for i in ('TK-xr7fgoia','TK-6emrxewd') if i not in o];print('cost --research misses:',miss or 'none');sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
